chaos-realm-composer.copy: region cells (PORTAL becomes FLOOR), its props except portals, focals, landmarks, pools, tendrils, chains, filaments, rooms, plane lights, moss
chaos-realm-composer.gates: island 1 and 5 need 1 gate, 2-4 need 2; reuse the template's original gate 2x2s first if still clear (2x2 clear FLOOR of the island, no prop, not reserved, not covering the island spawn, plus at least one clear edge-adjacent apron cell; arrival = the original arrival if it is on the apron, else the first apron cell in scan order); else the clear 2x2 with the greatest Manhattan distance (>= 6) from the existing gates (or from the island spawn when none), ties lower y then lower x
chaos-realm-composer.links: 4 links: island i gate (i=1: gates[0], else gates[1]) to island i+1 gates[0]; ids chaos-link-N-a / -b; label "To <other island name>"; each endpoint uses its own island's portal art
chaos-realm-composer.ruling: ruled 2026-10-15: no chaos biome gives more than 3 of a floor's 5 islands (draws without exceeding 3), so no island shape repeats on a floor

encounters.rosterUse: roster listed twice (12); creature id = chaos-<slug>; groups of 3 in roster order
encounters.candidate: island cell, FLOOR, no prop, no living actor; Chebyshev >= 6 from the floor arrival; Chebyshev >= 4 from the island spawn, every portal arrival and every portal cell; >= 2 open cardinal neighbours and not exactly two opposite ones
encounters.placement: up to 64 attempts until all 12 fit (attempt 0 uses the first jitter; later attempts redraw every jitter); spacing Chebyshev >= 2 for attempts 0-31, >= 1 after; gorehound needs >= 3 open neighbours; score = jitter x 2 + min(10, nearest safety distance) x 0.15; group leader: + min(12, nearest chosen) x 0.55; followers: - |distance to leader - 3| x 0.7; highest score wins, first in scan order on ties; the best attempt is kept; fewer than 12 is an error

rules: one patch per source creature: a new patch replaces its old one
at most 8 patches per floor: the oldest is dropped
a victim takes only the strongest patch per pulse; the Poison status uses the longest poisonTurns among all patches it stands in (so a stronger plain patch over a carrier patch still poisons)
first damage on the first world pulse after the patch is laid; it hurts on exactly 3 pulses
airborne victims are spared; only the player and allies are hurt; damage source is the creature, or "The poison cloud" if it is gone
travel and auto-explore treat patch tiles as hazards
water on a tile removes that tile from every patch

travel.floorsKept: leaving a floor stores it whole (map, creatures, items, explored tiles); returning restores it exactly
travel.downLog: You climb back down to floor N. It is as you left it.
travel.upLog: You climb back up to floor N. It is as you left it.
travel.forgeReminder: The Elemental Forge still burns on this floor.
travel.stairsHint: Down to floor N: > or click.
travel.upHint: Up to floor N: < or click.
travel.landing: a random reachable free tile of an ordinary room on the next floor (not special, pocket, boss, burning or clouded)
travel.noFallOn: boss floors and the last floor: moved to the nearest walkable tile
travel.fallenFoes: a fallen foe (not boss, flier, part, or on the last floor) arrives on the next floor's nearest safe floor tile outside pockets, specials and puzzles, acting 100 after the hero; a key holder drops its key first
travel.bossExit: the exit gate opens when the floor's core is pressed into it (packet D); stepping on the open gate descends, or wins on the last floor
